description: This Java source file defines an abstract actor class 'AbstractThingProxyActor' which extends 'AbstractProxyActor', managing command handling and message forwarding for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up specific behaviors for various command types including DevOps, retrieve, sudo retrieve, query, and general commands/signals within an Akka-based actor system.

classes.name: AbstractThingProxyActor
classes.description: Abstract class extending 'AbstractProxyActor', managing command and signal message handling related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto actor system.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the actor with references to mediator, devOps commands, and concierge forwarder, and creating the aggregator proxy actor.
